egali.top.Site description:
egali.top anarchist mailbox
Email, like the old internet intended: hosted from a small physical server in the operator's bedroom. No ads, no analytics, no big-tech hosting stack, Cloudflare/AWS free, Tor-friendly, independent / non-profit. 100 MB per mailbox.
egali.top.Note: Operator's own warning: no SLA, occasional downtime, prefer not to use as a primary mailbox. Mailboxes are sold for Monero via Session (@egalitop) or shop.egali.top. Abuse contact: abuse@egali.top.

elektrine.com.Price: free (Alpha: 1 GB, 3 aliases); Omega $6/month or $58/year (100 GB, unlimited aliases), paid in Monero
